name: 12-assign-refuses-confirm-count
pack_def:
# Correlate by assignment: every track in one system track, decided at each
# tick by the least-cost assignment of each source's tracks. A track joins a
# system track when it is within the 99 % region of the system track's fused
# estimate (cost below new_cost = 9.21, chi-square 2 degrees of freedom), and
# passes the gate against every member. keep_bonus favors the current choice.
pack        correlate-assign
version     0.1.0
method      assign
filter      accel_var=1 default_ce_m=50 vel_sigma_ms=5 unknown_vel_ms=100
gate        mahalanobis gate=18.42
gate        same key=track.simulated
gate        same key=@env
new_cost    9.21
keep_bonus  2
stale_ms    120000
confirm_count  2
